loras.name: brdmc
loras.notes: Broderick recurring AUTHOR-AVATAR character-consistency LoRA (heavyset bald man, full gray beard, thick black rectangular glasses), trained on 17 isolated ink avatar crops. VALIDATED 2026-06-14: the bare 'brdmc, <pose>' trigger does NOT bind on Flux (yields inconsistent photoreal people, no ink). It WORKS when the prompt includes the ink style block + the avatar described + brdmc -> renders a CONSISTENT avatar in Broderick B&W ink across poses (see _training/samples/char/). USE: style-block + 'a heavyset bald man with a full gray beard and thick black rectangular glasses' + brdmc; scale ~0.9-1.0. Artifact: s3://ilyrium-slm-foundry/models/broderick/hand/char/broderick_char.safetensors -> aws s3 cp into ComfyUI/models/loras/.

loras.name: brdrck
loras.notes: Broderick ink/look STYLE LoRA v2 (173 panels, short trigger-only captions). GOAL was to make the bare 'brdrck' trigger fire the style; VALIDATED 2026-06-14 that it did NOT — bare trigger still inert on Flux (generic cartoon), same class of failure as v1. NOT an improvement over v1 for the trigger problem. BUT produces strong Broderick B&W ink when the style is DESCRIBED in the prompt (e.g. 'black and white hand-drawn ink comic, bold confident linework, loose cross-hatching, white background') — see _training/samples/flux_v2/. USE via style-block prepend (projects/broderick/style_kernel.json 'look'), NOT the bare trigger; scale ~0.85-1.0. Flux lesson: a rare trigger token does not bind a style the way SDXL does. Artifact: s3://ilyrium-slm-foundry/models/broderick/hand/flux_v2/broderick_flux_v2.safetensors -> aws s3 cp into ComfyUI/models/loras/.

loras.name: strp
loras.notes: Stripe CHARACTER LoRA v2 — recurring lead of the STRIPE series. Retrained on a CLEAN 19-image speedo set anchored to the user's canonical refs: IP-Adapter@0.6+brdrck poses with the bottom fixed shorts->speedo via expose-thighs Flux Fill inpaint, + brdrck-only speedo rears with the crack-stripe, + the user front ref. All attributes baked: bald Norwood-VII dome, light body hair, sunglasses, gold chain, gold bracelet (right wrist), brown sneakers, white speedo, rear crack-stripe. Supersedes v1 (stripe_char.safetensors, weak attributes). USE: stack with brdrck (strp@0.9 + brdrck@~0.8) + describe the scene; for rear/stripe panels use brdrck-only (the char LoRA over-fits front). Locked design: projects/stripe/lora_seeds/v6/ + refs/. Artifact: s3://ilyrium-slm-foundry/models/stripe/hand/char/stripe_char_v2.safetensors -> aws s3 cp into ComfyUI/models/loras/.

loras.name: stripe_young
loras.notes: YOUNG 1970s Stripe (KING SIZE / NH-S05 prequel lead). Fat canon body, FULL jet-black 70s hair (never bald), thin gold rope chain, shades, white briefs, brown sneakers, BW ink cartoon. Astria API tune 5282901 (flux1 branch, base 1504944, face_crop=false, trigger <lora:5282901:1.0> ohwx man) trained 2026-07-15 on the 3 approved picks in projects/stripe/03_design/characters/loras/stripe/1970s/. Astria API tunes have no downloadable ckpt - generate keyframes on Astria, or recreate the tune in the Astria web UI to get a portable .safetensors for ComfyUI, then backfill sha256 and set status=trained.

loras.name: valencia_strong_nh
loras.notes: Valencia Strong - New Harnomy USA. The one principal OUTSIDE the caste (see 01_development/bible/THE_CASTE.md); deliberately ethnically ambiguous (NH-USA-008) so the Framework cannot sort her. NOTE: her BEATIFIC/serene quality is NOT in this LoRA and must not be - that is Summer's. Valencia's register is grave and tired. Trained on fal fal-ai/flux-lora-portrait-trainer, 2000 steps, 18 images, subject_crop + multiresolution. Anchor: 03_design/characters/casting/finals/VAL-FINAL.png. Training set is gitignored and reproducible from 03_design/characters/training/gen_trainset.py (seeds 770000+i). VERIFIED 2026-09-03 on two out-of-set scene prompts each - identity generalises. Per this library's own precedent (broderick_char, broderick_flux_v2) a bare Flux trigger token does NOT bind: ALWAYS describe the character in the prompt as well as naming the trigger. Artifact: s3://ilyrium-slm-foundry/models/new_harnomy/valencia_strong_nh.safetensors -> aws s3 cp into ComfyUI/models/loras/ on the render box. Weights are gitignored (125 MB each); the repo keeps the .meta.json, the config, and the verification sheet.

loras.name: summer_winters_nh
loras.notes: Summer Winters - New Harnomy USA. IMPORTANT: her beatific radiance is a LIGHTING fact, not baked into these weights (NH-USA-020). The training set deliberately varied lighting so the LoRA learns her face, not her key light. To get the queen quality at render time the SHOT must supply it: a soft luminous key from just above and in front wrapping the cheekbones, a glow at forehead and temples, a bright catchlight in each eye, the brow unfurrowed, the lips resting closed rather than pressed.
